findings.evidence: grep: `ComplexLine.lean:87:lemma stdComplexSymplecticForm_apply_ofComplexModule_self (z : ℂ) :` gives `stdComplexSymplecticForm z (AlmostComplexStructure.ofComplexModule ℂ z) = z.re * z.re + z.im * z.im`; the analogous evaluator at line 81 is already `[simp]`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to `stdComplexSymplecticForm_apply_ofComplexModule_self` if it is intended as the canonical coordinate form.
findings.issue: `stdComplexSymplecticForm_apply_ofComplexModule_self` is the normal form for `ω(z, J z)` on the standard complex line, but it is not tagged `[simp]`, so positivity/energy computations cannot normalize this characteristic expression without naming the lemma manually.

findings.evidence: grep: `ComplexLine.lean:130:lemma stdComplexSymplecticForm_associatedBilinForm (z w : ℂ) :` exposes `stdComplexSymplecticForm.associatedBilinForm (AlmostComplexStructure.ofComplexModule ℂ) z w = z.re * w.re + z.im * w.im`, the normal coordinate form for this new API.
findings.fix: Tag `stdComplexSymplecticForm_associatedBilinForm` with `@[simp]` so `simp` rewrites the associated bilinear form to the real dot product.
findings.issue: `stdComplexSymplecticForm_associatedBilinForm` is the characteristic coordinate formula for the compatible metric, but it lacks `[simp]`, leaving downstream metric/energy goals stuck behind `associatedBilinForm`.

summary: The new public form has the needed coordinate formula, but two characteristic coordinate normal forms are exposed without the automation annotations downstream users need for native complex-line computations.
